basis: Reproductive sex cord-stromal tumor; variable hormone secretion does not establish a defining endocrine disorder.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: primarily a reproductive tumor; optional estrogenic or androgenic manifestations do not define the umbrella concept.

basis: Developmental impairment defines the syndrome; persistent ptosis in 80-99% supports ocular involvement. Clinodactyly in 80-99% lacks demonstrated functional damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: fifth-finger clinodactyly occurs in 80-99%, but this minor shape difference alone does not establish skeletal damage or impaired function.

basis: Codeine poisoning depresses the CNS and medullary respiratory drive; respiratory suppression alone is not direct lung damage.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory depression is centrally mediated; direct pulmonary injury is not a defining or established common feature.

basis: GRIN2D encephalopathy causes seizures and developmental impairment. Pes planus in 2/2 does not establish skeletal dysfunction; cerebral visual impairment is neurologic.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: pes planus in 2/2 meets the frequency threshold but does not by itself demonstrate damaging skeletal disease; abnormal tone is neurologic.

basis: Intention tremor and ataxia define neurologic dysfunction; lipofuscin deposition alone does not establish a metabolic disorder. Premature graying does not establish skin damage.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: nonspecific metabolism/homeostasis annotation and lipofuscin accumulation do not establish a defined inborn metabolic disorder.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia, valvular disease and thick skin (10/15) are defining features; airway stenosis 6/13 (46%). Intellectual disability 6/15 (40%) omitted by cap.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: persistent thickened skin is a characteristic diagnostic feature of geleophysic dysplasia, supported by 10/15 patients (67%).

basis: Immunodeficiency, developmental delay and defining autoimmune cytopenias (75-83%); bronchiectasis 3/6 (50%). Recurrent otitis alone does not establish lasting ear damage.

decisions.haematologic: primary: autoimmune hemolytic anemia and thrombocytopenia each affect 5/6; autoimmune cytopenias are a defining component of TPP2 deficiency.

basis: Mitochondrial metabolic disorder; developmental delay 2/3 and atrial septal defect 1/3 (~33%). Small samples; hepatic dysfunction frequency is not established.

decisions.hepatic: none: liver dysfunction has no frequency estimate; hyperammonemia and hypoglycemia alone do not establish direct hepatic damage in at least 30%.

basis: Chronic facial dermatosis; persistent blepharitis, meibomian dysfunction and ocular surface inflammation affect approximately 30-50%, beyond transient redness.

decisions.ocular: involved: chronic eyelid and ocular surface inflammation occurs in approximately 30-50%; severe corneal destruction is not required for involvement.

basis: Glycosylation-related myopathy; brain impairment and damaging eye anomalies each estimated >30% across the predominantly muscle-eye-brain spectrum; mild limb-girdle forms can spare both.

decisions.ocular: involved: muscle-eye-brain disease predominates in POMGNT1 myopathy; structural eye disease and retinal dysfunction are estimated to exceed 30% across the spectrum.
